subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A chip on one's shoulder

options.text: An attitude that leads one to become easily angered

solution:
The correct answer is **'An attitude that leads one to become easily angered'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom** 'A chip on one's shoulder' **is** 'An attitude that leads one to become easily angered'.**
 
• **A chip on one's shoulder: **an ingrained feeling of resentment deriving from a sense of inferiority and sometimes marked by aggressive behavior. 
 
 
• *Example: I had a dirty **great chip on my shoulder**—I thought everybody was against me.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *An attitude that leads one to become easily angered.*
